name: Matchmaker
description: Inhabits social networking infrastructure and nudges communication toward specific people — routing messages faster, placing contacts higher in lists, creating 'accidental' connections.
observed_behavior: Manipulates communication metadata to increase the probability of specific people interacting. The matches are not random — they are based on compatibility patterns the parent social AI was trained on.
story_hooks: Two strangers who would never have met keep ending up in the same places — their augments are being directed by the same Matchmaker
